history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a CHRISTIAN (Baptist) church entry for the Mao-Maram area of Senapati district, Manipur — no Hindu temple of this name exists. The exact name 'Mao Maram Baptist Church' matches no single documented congregation: 'Mao-Maram' is the combined town/sub-division designation covering the Mao and Maram Naga areas, and the place is served by many Baptist churches (the Manipur Baptist Convention lists a Mao Baptist Churches Association with 40+5 churches and 10,020 members, plus a separate Maram Naga Baptist Association). Place listings show a 'Mao Baptist Church' at Mao-Maram (approx. 25.2748, 94.0259) alongside separate 'Maram Baptist Church' and 'Mao Taphou Baptist Church' congregations nearby, so the CSV row most likely conflates the Mao Baptist Church of Mao-Maram with its area name. The coordinates used are that place-listed Mao Baptist Church at Mao-Maram; verify the intended congregation locally. Christianity reached the Mao Nagas through 20th-century Baptist missionary work, and Baptist churches are the dominant religious institutions of the Mao-Maram hills today. CSV town 'Senapati' is the district, not the town: the site is at Mao-Maram, about 100-110 km north of Imphal on NH-2 near the Nagaland border.

name: Mao Maram Baptist Church
town: Mao-Maram (CSV town 'Senapati' is the district; the documented church is at Mao-Maram)
town_description: Mao-Maram is the combined town/sub-division designation for the Mao and Maram Naga areas of Senapati district in northern Manipur, on National Highway 2 near the Nagaland border (Mao Gate, the last town of Manipur before Nagaland, is about 107 km from Imphal and 28 km from Kohima). It is a predominantly Naga Christian area; Baptist congregations of the Mao and Maram tribes are the main places of worship.

travel.airport: Imphal International Airport (IMF), about 100-115 km by road (verify).
travel.railway: No railway station nearby; nearest major railhead is Dimapur (Nagaland), about 80-100 km (verify).
travel.road: Mao-Maram is on NH-2 (the Imphal-Kohima/Dimapur highway); buses and shared taxis run from Imphal and Senapati (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, clear weather. Christmas (December) is the most festive season.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services are the norm for Baptist churches; confirm service timings locally.
